capabilities: type a trigger command to start verse insertion
look up a Bible verse by reference
insert the verse text into the current note
disambiguation: Not a Bible reader or study tool; it only inserts verse text into the current note.
extras: The README is a brief stub that mentions the plugin was refactored from another project but the source name is not given; it also carries the marketplace note that it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up and insert Bible verses by reference while writing.
summary: Bible-verse inserter that adds scripture text to notes from a trigger command plus a reference lookup.
